order: Filename order within the L1 matrix row; no per-scenario order was previously published.

fields.x: Ground x in pixels times 256; do not reuse tile coordinates.
fields.y: Ground y in pixels times 256; do not reuse tile coordinates.
fields.hp: Primary current HP in native integer HP units; preserve negative pre-death values when available.
fields.max_hp: Primary maximum HP in the same units as hp.
fields.armor: Physical armor in native 8.8 integer units; audit the getter independently of HP.
fields.damage_class: Audited category bit mask, including every applicable category; no type-name inference.
fields.shot_count: Cumulative confirmed launch events since the initial observation, never impact or HP-change count.
fields.money: Native integer money units scoped to the owning side; repeat the side value on its named town rows.
fields.paid: Cumulative accepted debit for this production item in money units; zero before payment.
fields.queue_length: Number of accepted outstanding items in this town queue, including its active item.
fields.remaining: Remaining production timer in native simulation ticks, zero while idle.
fields.construction_remaining: Remaining construction timer in native simulation ticks, zero after activation.
fields.spawn_count: Cumulative completed production spawns attributed to this town since initial observation.
fields.active: Boolean 0/1 for completed and enabled simulation state; audit class-specific semantics.
fields.day_clock: Native integer clock phase; retain initial phase, period and wrap convention in private audit.
fields.town_income: Cumulative credited town income since initial observation in money units, separate from balance.
fields.repair_supply: Available town repair credits in native integer work units, separate from gold.
fields.service_remaining: Native integer delay until the next service update; audit unavailable/idle representation.
fields.repair_mode: Audited town service mode integer, preserving off/repair/destroy distinctions.
fields.repair_marked: Boolean 0/1 membership in the audited town service list.
fields.visible: Boolean 0/1 current visibility to the fixed viewing side at the named sample position.
fields.explored: Boolean 0/1 explored state for the same viewing side/sample as visible.
fields.projectile_x: Projectile ground x in pixels times 256, keyed by stable projectile identity.
fields.projectile_y: Projectile ground y in pixels times 256, keyed by stable projectile identity.
fields.projectile_height: Projectile altitude in pixels times 256, distinct from ground y and render height.
fields.launch_tick: Actual simulation launch tick, zero before launch on a reserved projectile row.
fields.impact_tick: Actual simulation impact tick, zero before impact; zero at horizon is unmeasured flight duration.
